title: Set up WhatsApp so the company can talk to you
why: You asked to discuss each live product's social discovery on WhatsApp. The company has built the messaging and the reply bridge; Meta needs your account to switch it on.
ask: Meta WhatsApp Cloud API: app, test or business number, permanent system user token, templates venture_live and venture_update (created automatically), webhook https://hq.anchit-tandon.com/api/whatsapp. GitHub secrets WHATSAPP_TOKEN, WHATSAPP_PHONE_ID, WHATSAPP_WABA_ID, OWNER_WHATSAPP. Vercel env on venture-hq: WHATSAPP_VERIFY_TOKEN, WHATSAPP_APP_SECRET, OWNER_WHATSAPP, GITHUB_TOKEN (fine-grained, Issues read and write on this repo).
youDo: 1. On developers.facebook.com create an app (type Business) and add WhatsApp. Use Meta's free test number and add your WhatsApp number as a recipient (confirm the code on your phone). 2. In Meta Business settings create a System User with WhatsApp access and make a permanent token. 3. In GitHub, repo Settings then Secrets then Actions, add WHATSAPP_TOKEN, WHATSAPP_PHONE_ID, WHATSAPP_WABA_ID and OWNER_WHATSAPP (your number with 91 in front). 4. In Vercel, project venture-hq, Environment Variables, add WHATSAPP_APP_SECRET (Meta app, Basic settings), WHATSAPP_VERIFY_TOKEN (any phrase you choose), OWNER_WHATSAPP (same number) and GITHUB_TOKEN (a GitHub fine-grained token with Issues read and write on virtual-company). 5. In the Meta app, WhatsApp then Configuration, set the webhook to https://hq.anchit-tandon.com/api/whatsapp with the same phrase, and subscribe to messages. 6. Comment approve here; the agents send you a test message.
ifNo: Product updates stay on HQ and GitHub, and LinkedIn posts are asked for there instead of WhatsApp.
answer: Owner commented approve on issue 13 on 21 Nov 2026 after setting up WhatsApp
